about.title: About Me
about.p1: I am Ali Ghaemi — a graphic designer, illustrator and photographer. For years I have lived with colour, line and form, working on illustration, branding and photography projects.
about.p2: I believe good design is not merely beautiful — it must speak, convey feeling and endure. This collection is a window into my professional and creative world.

contact.title: Let's create something lasting together.
contact.desc: If you have a project or would like to talk, please get in touch.
contact.letterP1: Thank you for taking the time to come this far. If you are reading this page, it means some of my work has caught your attention — and that is truly valuable to me.
contact.letterP2: I believe the best work begins with an honest conversation. It may concern a major project, a small commission, or simply an exchange of thoughts about art. Whichever it is, I would be glad to hear from you.
contact.letterP3: If you would like to collaborate, please choose one of the options below. I usually reply within 24 hours.
contact.methodsDesc: Choose the method that suits you best.
contact.closingTitle: I look forward to hearing from you.
contact.closingDesc: Whether it is a raw idea or a defined project, I read every message with care.

aboutPage.title: My Story
aboutPage.subtitle: A brief account of the path that brought me here.
aboutPage.s1p1: Since childhood, a simple yet profound question has never left my mind: “Who am I?” This search led me to art.
aboutPage.s1p2: In art, I found I could speak without uttering a word. That was the beginning of my path.
aboutPage.s2p1: For me, art is not merely a skill; it is a language for expressing what words cannot contain.
aboutPage.s2p2: In painting, illustration and photography, I create narratives rooted in observation, reflection and feeling.
aboutPage.s3p1: Today, drawing on academic knowledge and practical experience, I work on projects that aim to create beauty and meaning.
